cohort: 1193 pregnant women and their neonates at a tertiary level maternity hospital between March 2007 and 2011.
finding: Obesity was a significant risk factor for pregnancy complications, but not for adverse neonatal outcomes, while diabetes worsened neonatal outcomes.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery rates were significantly higher in the diabetes group both with normal and increased body mass index.
gest_age: Earlier gestational age at birth in the diabetic group
birth_weight: Higher birth weights in the diabetic group compared to the control group
